# Canary — world risk status as_of 2026-11-05T05:47Z · next run ~11:40 UK · stale after 2026-11-05T19:47Z (36h for daily-tier signals) Assessed by an AI model (Anthropic Claude) against published rubrics; attention levels, not forecasts or advice. CC BY 4.0 · https://canary.danleech.com Basis: 26 measured from open data, 13 follow a published figure, 50 are AI judgements from news reports (weigh these with more caution). Known limitations: https://canary.danleech.com/methodology#known-limits
World State 38/100 (Unsettled) · 16 Alert · 37 Watch · 36 Normal Headline: Hormuz stays largely shut as Iran rejects the US reply to its reopening plan and the IRGC claims tanker mine strikes; Russia hit Ukraine's grid in nine regions on 3–4 Nov. The Bank of England decides on rates on 5 Nov.
## Situations (8 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, stable]: Iran called the US reply to its Hormuz plan unconvincing on 3 Nov; IRGC claimed four tankers hit mines on 4 Nov. Brent near $94 on 5 Nov. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, oil, eu-gas, fertiliser, chokepoints, freight, uk-energy-cap; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, worsening]: Russia fired about 300 drones and 76 missiles at Ukraine's grid on 3–4 Nov, hitting nine regions; talks set for 10–11 Nov in Abu Dhabi. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI rose to +2.5 for Aug–Oct: drought risk in East and southern Africa, record-range warmth and faster CO₂ growth. → alert: enso, global-temp; watch: drought, co2, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: ECDC counted 10,274 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,992 deaths in DR Congo to 28 Oct; imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria; a WHO PHEIC since May. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: Drone strikes have cut parts of Sudan off the power grid; a strike on a South Kordofan fuel station killed 10 on 4 Nov. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - France: debt stress and protests [ALERT, stable]: OAT–Bund spread near 160bp on 2 Nov; budget vote delayed and unions hold a general strike on 5 Nov. → alert: sovereign-debt; watch: civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: US CPI 4.0%; Australia hiked to 4.85% on 3 Nov and a Bank of England rise to 4% is expected on 5 Nov. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility; normal: em-stress - Binance theft and North Korean escalation [WATCH, worsening]: FBI blames North Korea for a $6.3bn Binance theft; Pyongyang denied it and fired several missiles on 4 Nov. Binance withdrawals have resumed. → watch: cyber, korea
## Other Alerts - Global food prices [food-prices] stable, AI-judged: FAO food price index 136.0 in September, above the 135 Alert line; October due 6 Nov - UK terrorism threat level [uk-threat-level] stable: UK national threat level Severe: an attack is highly likely
